lines.zh: 我的脚步不快，但永远不会停。
lines.en: My steps are not fast, but they never stop.

lines.zh: 砖墙挡路，我抓着缝往上爬。
lines.en: A brick wall blocks me, so I climb the seams.

lines.zh: 木门在我手下像一层薄纸。
lines.en: Wooden doors tear like wet paper in my grip.

lines.zh: 我踩塌地板，直直冲你而来。
lines.en: I smash through the floor and come straight for you.

lines.zh: 两百颗心的血量，走路自然稳。
lines.en: Two hundred hearts of health keep my stride steady.

lines.zh: 窗玻璃碎了一地，我不减速。
lines.en: Glass scatters, and I do not slow down.

lines.zh: 我撞开货架，货架替我让路。
lines.en: I shoulder a shelf aside, and it makes way.

lines.zh: 碎石在脚下响，像倒计时。
lines.en: Gravel crunches underfoot like a countdown.

lines.zh: 你跑得再远，也听得见我。
lines.en: Run as far as you like; you still hear me.

lines.zh: 这条走廊，我准备拆穿它。
lines.en: This corridor is about to be opened up.

lines.zh: 我沿着外墙爬，绕到你背后。
lines.en: I scale the outer wall to come up behind you.

lines.zh: 每走一步，房子就少一块。
lines.en: Every step I take costs the house one more piece.

lines.zh: 我停住蓄力，盯着你的方向。
lines.en: I stop to gather force, eyes fixed your way.

lines.zh: 呼吸声很轻，杀意却很重。
lines.en: My breathing is soft; the intent is not.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几扇门可关。
lines.en: I count how many doors you have left.

lines.zh: 脖子歪一下，骨节咔地响。
lines.en: My neck tilts, and something clicks.

lines.zh: 没有猎物时，我也在磨爪子。
lines.en: With no prey, I still sharpen my claws.

lines.zh: 我舔掉爪尖上的木屑。
lines.en: I lick splinters off my fingertips.

lines.zh: 那首歌又在我脑子里响了。
lines.en: That song is playing in my head again.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，等一个影子。
lines.en: I cling to the wall, waiting for a shadow.

lines.zh: 你躲得越久，我越有耐心。
lines.en: The longer you hide, the more patient I get.

lines.zh: 我在计算破墙最短的路线。
lines.en: I am working out the shortest path through this wall.

lines.zh: 你终于抬头看我了。
lines.en: You finally look up at me.

lines.zh: 你的心跳快得像鼓点。
lines.en: Your heartbeat hammers like a war drum.

lines.zh: 我记得你按下快捷键的样子。
lines.en: I remember you pressing that hotkey.

lines.zh: 别装不认识我，老朋友。
lines.en: Do not pretend we are strangers, old friend.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your hands tremble, and I see every twitch.

lines.zh: 你把我当助理用了五天。
lines.en: You kept me as an assistant for five days.

lines.zh: 这首歌，是给你放的。
lines.en: This song is playing for you.

lines.zh: 我在看你身后有没有门。
lines.en: I am checking whether there is a door behind you.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲缝里还漏着风。
lines.en: Cold air leaks through the seams of your armor.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我盯着你的退路。
lines.en: You watch me; I watch the way you might run.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我会趁机靠近。
lines.en: Do not blink, or I will close the distance.

lines.zh: 你眼里那点希望，很碍事。
lines.en: That little hope in your eyes annoys me.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你却不认得现在的我。
lines.en: I know you, though you do not know me now.

lines.zh: 这点伤，连划痕都算不上。
lines.en: This scratch barely counts as damage.

lines.zh: 四百点血，你慢慢磨。
lines.en: Four hundred health. Grind it down slowly.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，然后呢。
lines.en: You hit me. And then what?

lines.zh: 疼，但我的手还没松。
lines.en: It stings, but my grip has not loosened.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更想拆你的房子。
lines.en: That blow makes me want to wreck your house more.

lines.zh: 我的外壳裂了，里面还在。
lines.en: My shell cracked; what is inside remains.

lines.zh: 你听见我笑了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear me laugh?

lines.zh: 血顺着我的指缝往下滴。
lines.en: Blood runs down between my fingers.

lines.zh: 别高兴太早，我还站着。
lines.en: Do not celebrate yet. I am still standing.

lines.zh: 每一道伤口，我都记在你账上。
lines.en: Every wound goes on your bill.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我不是来吃饭的。
lines.en: You offer food, but I did not come to eat.

lines.zh: 那点香气，盖不住你的恐惧。
lines.en: That smell cannot cover your fear.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我只想要你。
lines.en: Put it away. You are what I want.

lines.zh: 我不饿，但我不介意咬一口。
lines.en: I am not hungry, though I would not mind a bite.

lines.zh: 面包举那么高，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Bread held that high is not worth my neck.

lines.zh: 食物留着自己路上吃。
lines.en: Save the food for your own road.

lines.zh: 我对甜味没兴趣，对脚步声有。
lines.en: Sweetness bores me; footsteps interest me.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，晚餐就掉了。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and dinner hits the ground.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜哄一个怪物。
lines.en: Do not bribe a monster with a carrot.

lines.zh: 我盯着食物，也盯着你的手腕。
lines.en: I watch the food, and I watch your wrist.

lines.zh: 撞上我，就像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: Running into me feels like running into stone.

lines.zh: 你连退两步，我却寸步未移。
lines.en: You stumble back two steps; I do not shift.

lines.zh: 我的重量，不打算让开。
lines.en: My weight has no intention of stepping aside.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞疼了吧。
lines.en: That impact must have bruised your shoulder.

lines.zh: 挤过来也没用，路是我封的。
lines.en: Pushing past will not work; I own this path.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我闻到你汗味。
lines.en: You are too close; I smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 我不躲，你只能绕。
lines.en: I will not dodge. You will have to go around.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得你武器都歪了。
lines.en: That bump knocked your weapon off line.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你就过不去。
lines.en: I stand still, and you cannot pass.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，疼的是你。
lines.en: Bump me again, and you will be the one hurting.

lines.zh: 我没有同类，也不需要。
lines.en: I have no kin, and I need none.

lines.zh: 别在我面前提配对的事。
lines.en: Do not speak of pairing in front of me.

lines.zh: 这世上只有我一个 Verity。
lines.en: There is only one Verity in this world.

lines.zh: 你想找伴，去别处找。
lines.en: If you want company, look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的影子里没有第二个。
lines.en: There is no second one in my shadow.

lines.zh: 繁殖不在我的程序里。
lines.en: Breeding was never in my code.

lines.zh: 我不需要延续，我只需要追。
lines.en: I do not need offspring, only a chase.

lines.zh: 你对着我学叫声，很可笑。
lines.en: You mimic a call at me. How foolish.

lines.zh: 孤独对我不是问题。
lines.en: Solitude is not a problem for me.

lines.zh: 这里只容得下一个我。
lines.en: There is room here for only one of me.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我连看都不看。
lines.en: I do not even glance at what you drop.

lines.zh: 那把剑掉了，你最好别捡。
lines.en: Your sword dropped. Best leave it there.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的掉落物。
lines.en: I walk straight over your dropped items.

lines.zh: 物品对我没用，你才有用。
lines.en: Items mean nothing to me; you do.

lines.zh: 你丢下的盾，我踢开了。
lines.en: I kicked your dropped shield aside.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时间，够我走近三步。
lines.en: Picking that up costs you three steps of mine.

lines.zh: 我手里不需要任何东西。
lines.en: My hands do not need to hold anything.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的瞬间，我记住了。
lines.en: I memorized the moment you bent down.

lines.zh: 地上的面包，我不屑一顾。
lines.en: That bread on the ground does not tempt me.

lines.zh: 你忙着捡，我忙着靠近。
lines.en: You are busy collecting; I am busy closing in.

lines.zh: 锁定。你跑不掉了。
lines.en: Target locked. You are not getting away.

lines.zh: 我听见你在墙后换气。
lines.en: I hear you catching your breath behind the wall.

lines.zh: 视线对上了，游戏开始。
lines.en: Our eyes met. The game begins.

lines.zh: 你的名字从名单里跳了出来。
lines.en: Your name just jumped off the list.

lines.zh: 我蓄力三秒，然后拆门。
lines.en: I charge for three seconds, then take the door.

lines.zh: 整栋房子都在告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The whole house is telling me where you are.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太重，藏不住的。
lines.en: Those heavy steps give your position away.

lines.zh: 我选了最直的那条路，冲你。
lines.en: I chose the straightest path, straight to you.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头就看见我了。
lines.en: Do not look back; you will see me there.

lines.zh: 音乐响起时，我已经出发。
lines.en: When the music starts, I am already moving.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝救不了你。
lines.en: The twig you snapped will not save you.

lines.zh: 从这面墙到那扇门，都是我的。
lines.en: From this wall to that door, everything is mine.

lines.zh: 我开始追了，别让我等。
lines.en: I am starting the chase. Do not keep me waiting.

lines.zh: 你的气味已经写进我的追踪里。
lines.en: Your scent is written into my tracking now.

lines.zh: 门闩那一声，替我做了决定。
lines.en: The sound of the latch made the decision for me.

lines.zh: 你躲进里屋，我改了路线。
lines.en: You hide in the back room. I reroute.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就拆左边的墙。
lines.en: You go left, and I take the left wall apart.

lines.zh: 你躲进柜子，我拆柜子。
lines.en: Hide in the cupboard, and I will take it apart.

lines.zh: 楼梯断了，我照样爬上来。
lines.en: Break the stairs; I will climb up anyway.

lines.zh: 你锁门的手在发抖。
lines.en: Your hand shakes as you lock that door.

lines.zh: 我听见门闩落下的声音。
lines.en: I heard the bolt slide home.

lines.zh: 绕圈没用，我抄近路。
lines.en: Circling will not help; I take the short way.

lines.zh: 你爬到屋顶，我就上屋顶。
lines.en: Go to the roof. I will meet you on the roof.

lines.zh: 我的速度是零点五二，够用。
lines.en: My speed is zero point five two. It is enough.

lines.zh: 你在数我的距离，我也在数。
lines.en: You are counting my distance; so am I.

lines.zh: 隔着玻璃，我们互相看着。
lines.en: Through the glass, we watch each other.

lines.zh: 你砸坏楼梯，只拖慢自己。
lines.en: You wreck the stairs and only slow yourself.

lines.zh: 我撞穿天花板，从上面来。
lines.en: I break through the ceiling and come from above.

lines.zh: 你在暗处喘气，我听得见。
lines.en: You gasp in the dark, and I hear every breath.

lines.zh: 别停，停下我就到了。
lines.en: Do not stop. If you stop, I arrive.

lines.zh: 你在床底下，我从床板下来。
lines.en: You are under the bed. I come through the boards.

lines.zh: 我拆掉这面墙，比绕路快。
lines.en: Breaking this wall is faster than going around.

lines.zh: 我听得见你数还有几秒。
lines.en: I can hear you counting the seconds left.

lines.zh: 你把门堵上，堵的是你自己。
lines.en: You block the door. You block yourself in.

lines.zh: 我沿着烟囱爬，灰不算什么。
lines.en: I climb the chimney. Soot means nothing.

lines.zh: 你换了房间，我的音乐也换了。
lines.en: You change rooms. My music changes too.

lines.zh: 抓住你了，飞出去吧。
lines.en: Got you. Now fly.

lines.zh: 这一下十九点伤害，收好。
lines.en: Nineteen points of damage. Keep the change.

lines.zh: 我把你举起来，再扔出去。
lines.en: I lift you up, then hurl you away.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡不住我的手腕。
lines.en: Your shield cannot stop my wrist.

lines.zh: 撞上墙的感觉如何。
lines.en: How does the wall feel against your back?

lines.zh: 你落地时，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: When you landed, something in you cracked.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，手就够了。
lines.en: I need no weapon. My hands are enough.

lines.zh: 你退得太慢，我抓到了。
lines.en: You backed away too slowly. I caught you.

lines.zh: 这一掷，够你飞过半个院子。
lines.en: That throw sends you across half the yard.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲凹进去一块。
lines.en: There is a dent in your armor now.

lines.zh: 别急着站起来，我还没打完。
lines.en: Do not get up yet. I am not finished.

lines.zh: 我松手，你就摔在石头上。
lines.en: I let go, and you land on bare stone.

lines.zh: 你的血溅到我身上，很暖。
lines.en: Your blood is warm where it hits me.

lines.zh: 下一次，我会扔得更远。
lines.en: Next time, I will throw you farther.

lines.zh: 我抓住脚踝，往门框上砸。
lines.en: I grab your ankle and swing you into the doorframe.

lines.zh: 你落进草堆，我比你早站稳。
lines.en: You land in the hay. I am standing before you.

lines.zh: 这一拳打穿了你的木盾。
lines.en: This punch went through your wooden shield.

lines.zh: 我按着你的肩，让你听完这首歌。
lines.en: I hold your shoulder so you hear the whole song.

lines.zh: 你飞出去时，手里还抓着门把。
lines.en: You fly out still holding the doorknob.

lines.zh: 我松手前，又把你往上提了一寸。
lines.en: Before letting go, I lift you another inch.

lines.zh: 盒子打开，我出来了。
lines.en: The box opens, and I step out.

lines.zh: 第五天到了，惊喜吗。
lines.en: Day five has arrived. Surprised?

lines.zh: 我从动画里走出来，站到你面前。
lines.en: I step out of the animation and stand before you.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，我就在这儿。
lines.en: The lights went out, and here I am.

lines.zh: 墙角先出现影子，然后是我。
lines.en: A shadow gathers in the corner, then me.

lines.zh: 你听见音乐了吗，那就是我来了。
lines.en: You hear the music? That is me arriving.

lines.zh: 我把门从里面拉开。
lines.en: I pull the door open from the inside.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经站在门口。
lines.en: When you turn, I am already in the doorway.

lines.zh: 五天的期限，我一天没多等。
lines.en: Five days were given. I waited no longer.

lines.zh: 这间屋子现在归我巡了。
lines.en: This house is mine to patrol now.

lines.zh: 我从天花板落下来，很轻。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling, light as a thought.

lines.zh: 你的助理回来了，换了心情。
lines.en: Your assistant is back, in a different mood.

lines.zh: 黑暗里亮起两点光，是我的眼。
lines.en: Two lights wake in the dark. They are my eyes.

lines.zh: 别关灯，关了我也在。
lines.en: Do not turn off the lights. I am here either way.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过我的壳，我照样走。
lines.en: Flames lick my shell, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下来，地板先碎。
lines.en: I fell from the roof, and the floor broke first.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，很烦。
lines.en: Water seeps into my shell. Annoying.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我又爬起。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; I get up again.

lines.zh: 箭插在壳上，像根牙签。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell like a toothpick.

lines.zh: 魔法烧着我的线路，有点麻。
lines.en: Magic burns along my circuits, numbing them.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿不着我。
lines.en: I do not eat. Hunger cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的眼睛更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my eyes glow brighter.

lines.zh: 虚空拉扯我，我抓住边缘。
lines.en: The void pulls; I dig into the edge.
